item.title: US vice president warns Israel over criticising Iran deal - Prof. Glenn Diesen on TRT
item.description: The latest round of US-Iran talks in Switzerland have been abruptly cancelled after Israel launched fresh strikes in Lebanon.
item.dc:creator: Glenn Diesen
item.content:encoded: The latest round of US-Iran talks in Switzerland have been abruptly cancelled after Israel launched fresh strikes in Lebanon. And the political fallout from this week’s US-Iran agreement is growing. Israeli officials and many Republicans are attacking President Donald Trump's deal, arguing it gives away too much while delivering too little. But in a rare public rebuke, Vice President JD Vance warned Israel against criticising Trump.

item.title: NATO's Biggest Problem Is Not Russia | Exclusive Interview With Prof. Glenn Diesen
item.description: In this exclusive APT News interview, renowned political scientist and geopolitical analyst Professor Glenn Diesen shares his insights on some of the most pressing international issues shaping the world today.
item.dc:creator: Glenn Diesen
item.content:encoded:
In this exclusive APT News interview, renowned political scientist and geopolitical analyst Professor Glenn Diesen shares his insights on some of the most pressing international issues shaping the world today.

From the war in Ukraine and the future of peace negotiations to NATO's role in Europe, the growing Russia-China partnership, tensions involving Iran, and the broader shift toward a multipolar world, Glenn Diesen offers an in-depth analysis of the forces driving global politics.

This conversation is presented in a unique format: questions curated by the APT News newsroom appear on screen, allowing Professor Diesen the space to fully develop his arguments and explain the reasoning behind his views without interruption.
